scope: Existing out/ext-*.audit.json; no new extraction. Working-tree schema/runtime inspected read-only; concurrent staged changes may exist.

unresolved: payment_plan row in §9 conflicts with §7 (never ask how much, never offer a new instalment plan); not compiled.

Deadline-before-today case (no promise, close cr-none/cr-r-refused) has no IR field.
Effective floor combines a base field, a 25% rule rounded up to the cent, and a cap at full; the floor_rules DSL cannot express it natively, encoded with extra keys.
Callback must be on the next business day AND that day must be Tuesday or Thursday; the IR cannot express the weekday restriction (no eligible slot otherwise).
No dictated debt-intro sentence; only content (every product, amount, days late) is required.
Wording of the hardship sympathetic sentence is not dictated.
refuse_to_talk second refusal before verification closes ID-STOP/NO-CHECK, while after verification it marks remaining products DECLINE; the IR has one action per case.

Third-party non-disclosure, missing callback time must be asked, below-earliest-date proposals offered the earliest eligible date, and 'never offer discount/waiver/new plan' are behavioural rules without dedicated IR fields.
